title: Count lines in a file
summary: Use the `wc` command to count the number of lines in a text file. This is useful for checking the size of logs, code files, or documents.

steps.explain: Run the `wc` command with the `-l` flag followed by the path to your file to count the lines.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the file you want to count lines in.

steps.expect: The terminal will output the number of lines followed by the filename.
